I am 50 this year, and I have farmed these 7 mu for 30 years. I finished middle school. My wife works in a small factory in town, so in the busy season I hire one or two people for a few days, but mostly I work alone. I have 4 mu of spring maize and 3 mu of cotton. I do not plant wheat — I rotary-till the whole field in late March and plant the maize in mid-April. The cotton plot I also rotary-till and plant in late April.

For the maize, I buy Denghai 605 hybrid seed from the dealer in town again. I use about 2.5 jin of seed per mu. At sowing I spread one 50 kg bag of high-nitrogen compound fertilizer per mu — the kind with 28% nitrogen. That gives the roots a good start. When the plants reach the big-flare stage in July, I topdress with half a bag of urea per mu, about 25 kg. I do not calculate the exact nitrogen numbers, but the dealer told me this is about 18 kg of pure nitrogen per mu. Last year I cut back on fertilizer and the ears were small, so this year I will not reduce it. I spray herbicide once before emergence and insecticide once in summer when the armyworms come — 2 times total. I irrigate 3 times from my well: at sowing if the soil is dry, in July when it gets hot, and in August when the ears fill. I expect about 550 kg of grain per mu if rain comes at the right time.

For cotton, I use the improved variety 99-1. It is insect-resistant cotton, so the bollworm does not destroy it like the old days, but I still spray insecticide about 12 times from June to August for aphids and spider mites. I also spray herbicide twice. I put down one 50 kg bag of 15-15-15 compound fertilizer per mu at planting, and topdress with urea at flowering and boll-setting — about 15 kg each time. That works out to about 15 kg nitrogen, 6 kg phosphate, and 7 kg potash per mu. Cotton needs the potash for the bolls. I irrigate cotton 3 times too, especially during flowering when it cannot be dry. I expect around 280 kg of seed cotton per mu.

I spend about 1,500 yuan on chemical fertilizer and another 800 on pesticides and electricity for the well pump. It is a lot of money for a 7-mu farm, but my neighbor Lao Wang tried to save on fertilizer last year and his yield dropped badly. I would rather use a bit too much than risk losing the harvest. A bad year is a disaster; wasting some fertilizer is just a cost I can accept.
